archetype: localized-premium-valuation funnel that inherits the live Diamond Banc nationwide page. The design remains editorial luxury, with real client-owned jewelry and expert photography, a dark high-contrast hero, a bright appraisal card, serif display type, controlled teal actions, restrained gold rules, and generous white space. Localization comes from the city name, exact phone, and focused office copy, not city skylines or unrelated local stock.

palette.contrast_verdict: White on #1C7E86 measures 4.8:1 and white on #222428 measures 15.54:1. Gold on #222428 measures 5.22:1. Gold is decorative only on white.

typography.display: Cormorant Garamond, weights 400, 600, and 700, for premium editorial headings
typography.body: Poppins, weights 400, 500, 600, and 700, for body copy, labels, controls, and buttons
typography.scale: Preserve the existing fluid mobile-first scale; H1 remains at least 39px on a 390px viewport and reaches roughly 66px on desktop

spacing.container: max-width 1280px with 20px mobile and 32px desktop gutters
spacing.grid: 12 columns on desktop, one column on mobile; hero copy spans 6 and form spans 5 with one-column breathing room

components.notes: Preserve embed code and compact spacing

sections.hero: Localize the H1 and market context only; keep the approved visual and widget hierarchy.
sections.local-office: Replace the all-market map on localized routes with a focused market panel, city name, appointment language, and the exact route phone.
sections.proof: Keep the current approved proof and real testimonials unchanged except for necessary local context.
sections.final-cta: Repeat the local market name and exact route phone while using the approved quote copy and chip order.

imagery_direction: Use the existing verified Diamond Banc photography already committed in public/images. Do not generate, synthesize, or source new city imagery. The offering remains the subject: valuable jewelry, watches, secure shipping, and experienced people.

iconography.direction: Reuse the existing small single-color line icon system.

motion.direction: Subtle opacity and vertical reveal only; form and phone controls remain immediately interactive.

motion_direction: Subtle opacity and vertical reveal only; form and phone controls are immediately interactive.
mobile_first_notes: The appraisal card must begin within the first 480px of a 390px viewport as closely as the current approved pattern allows
The route phone must remain readable and tappable in the fixed header
The floating CTA is quote-form only and must not add a duplicate phone CTA
inspiration_refs: The current live Diamond Banc nationwide route is the primary and binding design exemplar.
rationale: The customer requested the same nationwide content framework localized by market. Preserving the live page's design system reduces risk to an active paid-traffic asset, keeps customer-approved proof and imagery intact, and isolates the new work to route-aware content and phone values.
